text:
送付済です<@U08KVN5B6HX>
```Dear Harvey-san,

Thank you so much for your valuable time during our visit in January. 
The information & insights you shared about Taiwan's approach have been instrumental, and we have been actively building on them to advance our project here in Japan.

I am writing because we have been given an opportunity in 23rd March to present directly to approximately 30 members of the Liberal Democratic Party at the LDP headquarters, reporting on Taiwan's initiatives and their relevance to Japan. We have also heard that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has expressed interest in this project.

We are very eager to move this forward in Japan, and I apologize for the detailed nature of the request, but would it be possible for you to provide answers to the questions in the attached spreadsheet?

We believe that if Japan also makes progress in negotiations with platforms, this would be mutually beneficial for Taiwan as well.

Regarding timeline:
- Written responses by email: by March 19th (you do not need to answer all questions by the deadline — please prioritize the higher-priority items. i.e. P1)
- Online meeting: sometime between March 20–24 (if you can help us answer the replies via text we are happy with it.)

Please find the question list attached. Each question is marked with a priority level (P1/P2/P3) for your reference.
I also set up a google spreadsheet link so if you are comfortable using it please do so.

<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1C8dGY7TUtx5vPVeGDllLFF9iYOmNJRgQoAYPS-4ssdY/edit?pli=1&gid=1203123034#gid=1203123034>

Thank you very much for your continued support.
We truly appreciate the partnership between our teams.

Best regards,
Naofumi Nishida```

<@U08KVN5B6HX> <@U09C3J7V960>
3/19に名前を掲載させていただく打診先についてご相談です。
有識者との接点の状況について<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1isqRSUvvympiNp8uKBWYHIAI8-CGNjePriZUfrN4qig/edit?tab=t.bh56kawsg0l3|こちら>にまとめています。現在意見交換ができているのは水谷先生含め三人＋3/18に曽我部先生です。
• 声かけ先候補
    ◦ 3/19にお名前を出してもらう観点では、JICDAQ小出事務局長・京都大学曽我部先生が候補です。
    ◦ 曽我部先生は3/18に意見交換をして賛意があればその場でご相談という流れを想定しています。
    ◦ 北九州市立大の山本健人先生は、改めて考えて、曽我部・水谷先生との被りが大きいので、対象外とするか、曽我部先生が忙しくて協力が難しいということであれば3/19以降にはなりますが改めて打診先として検討するのはどうかと考えています。
